news.title: Murder suspect in custody in Johns Creek after standoff
news.summary: Police in Johns Creek say they were assisting Atlanta Police with serving a homicide warrant at a location on Nesbitt Ferry Road.

news.title: Murder suspect in custody after SWAT standoff in Johns Creek neighborhood
news.summary: NewsChopper 2 flew over the scene on Nesbitt Ferry Road, where there are multiple SWAT vehicles and officers outside a home.

news.title: Child hit by car on Campbellton Road in southwest Atlanta
news.summary: Police said the child was hit just before 7 a.m. near Camp Ground Road.

news.title: Suspect denied bond, judge finds probable cause to continue case forward in killing of woman found dismembered in Smyrna
news.summary: Kingston Bradley, 18, is charged with the murder of 26-year-old Shanteria “KT” Mosley.

news.title: 2 officers, suspect hurt after shots fired in Woodstock
news.summary: The Georgia Bureau of Investigation is investigating an officer-involved shooting in Woodstock Thursday night.

news.title: Driver flees Cobb traffic stop before Atlanta crash
news.summary: A driver fled a Cobb County police traffic stop Thursday night before crashing in Atlanta and running from the scene, authorities said.

news.title: Man sentenced for $500K scam targeting Sandy Springs elderly resident
news.summary: A man has been sentenced to 14 years in federal prison after defrauding an elderly Sandy Springs resident out of approximately $500,000 in an imposter scheme, police announced.

news.title: Paulding County Sheriff’s Office uses new DNA testing for first time to seek killer in 21-year-old cold case
news.summary: Regan Wheeler, a devoutly religious man, was shot in his driveway on Oct. 13, 2005. DNA testing is underway on the shell casings found at the crime scene.

news.title: Police: Suspect reportedly told Woodstock officers he had a weapon
news.summary: A suspicious-person call near Paden and Maple streets led police to a retention pond in downtown Woodstock Thursday evening.

news.title: FBI offering reward of up to $20K for information after Molotov cocktail thrown at Atlanta ICE office
news.summary: The day after the arson attempt happened, the FBI released photos of the person they were looking for in connection with the crime.

news.title: Man claiming to be deaf wanted in Covington gas station theft, police say
news.summary: Covington police are asking for the public's help to identify a theft suspect who claimed to be deaf before escaping in an SUV earlier this month.

news.title: Fulton County jury convicts man for repeatedly molesting 10-year-old girl while he was caring for her
news.summary: The case stems from a September 2019 report in which the victim’s mother told police her 10-year-old daughter had been sexually abused.

news.title: Family seeks answers after 16-year-old killed in Clayton County
news.summary: A Clayton County family is pleading for answers after 16-year-old Jayden Miller was shot and killed during a fight at a Jonesboro apartment complex.

news.title: Van Zandt County gathers to pray for Deputy Adam Sherifi, killed in shootout near Canton
news.summary: Dozens gathered at the Van Zandt County Courthouse to pray for Deputy Adam Sherifi, killed in a shootout while serving a warrant near Canton Tuesday night.

news.title: Clayton County officer dragged out of hospital; search for driver continues
news.summary: Police in Clayton County are searching for a suspect who allegedly dragged an officer during a traffic stop Wednesday afternoon.
